result.title: Generalized CycleGRPO for Fine-Grained Multimodal Understanding and Grounding
result.summary: Fine-grained multimodal intelligence requires models to both understand a designated region and localize it from language. Existing methods learn these directions with separate objectives and task-specific annotations. We present Generalized CycleGRPO, the first unified reinforcement learning framework coupling region understanding and localization across spatial, temporal, and spatio-temporal domains. Given a region, a multimodal large language model generates candidate descriptions and then localizes each description to reconstruct the input region. Reconstruction overlap provides a verifiable reward for captioning, while individual localization rewards improve the inverse mapping. A common region-space formulation extends this cycle from image masks and boxes to video intervals and timestamped spatial evidence, without reference captions or an external language-model judge during reinforcement learning. In videos, the cycle encourages descriptions that distinguish a target event from similar recurrences. We introduce DOVE (Distinctive Occurrence-level Video-caption Evaluation), a human-verified contrastive benchmark for this temporal distinctiveness. CycleGRPO improves SAMTok's overall gIoU from 57.5% to 68.2% on GroundingSuite and average gIoU from 71.2% to 78.7% on GRES. For temporal tasks, it achieves 51.9% tIoU on Charades and 33.3% Temporal Evidence Coverage on DOVE, compared with 45.6% and 14.8% for the Qwen3-VL initialization. These results establish region-text cycle consistency as a general self-evaluation principle for multimodal understanding and localization. Models, code, and DOVE are available at https://devinxzhang.github.io/Generalized-CycleGRPO-Page/.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Generalized CycleGRPO 统一强化学习框架，把「给定区域生成描述—再由描述反定位回原区域」的循环一致性作为可验证奖励，覆盖图像掩码/框与视频事件区间、时空证据，并提出对比式基准 DOVE 评测时序描述的可区分性。
AI.relevance_reason: 与细粒度视觉证据的使用和「贡献分配/自评监督」直接相关：循环重建重叠提供无需外部判官的奖励，可供核查其能否约束模型真正依赖区域细节而非语言先验；但工作聚焦 grounding 训练与基准，未涉及推理期 latent 状态生成与停止决策。
